blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Managing a general ledger at the Rise level means more than posting entries. It means keeping the ledger clean, explainable, and ready for any reasonable question. Each account should have a clear purpose, a documented rule for what goes in, and a regular check that nothing strange has appeared.

Good ledger managers review the top-risk accounts weekly: cash, accruals, prepaid, inter-company and suspense accounts. They clear suspense entries the same day. They reconcile cash accounts more often than the system demands, and they ask uncomfortable questions the moment a balance looks odd.

The ledger is the memory of the business. A well-kept ledger lets leaders trust what the numbers say. A neglected one quietly ages until a big question arrives that nobody can answer without a week of detective work.

items.q: According to the text, managing a general ledger means more than…
items.why: "means more than posting entries" — lançar não basta; o razão precisa ficar limpo e explicável.

items.q: How often do good ledger managers review the top-risk accounts?
items.why: "review the top-risk accounts weekly".

items.q: What does the text say good managers do with suspense entries?
options: Leave them for the annual audit
items.why: "They clear suspense entries the same day."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: An odd balance deserves an immediate question.
A clean ledger builds trust in the numbers.
Reconciling cash only when the system demands it is enough.
Each account should have a documented rule.
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia quem concilia "more often than the system demands", logo o mínimo do sistema não basta.

items.q: Calling the ledger "the memory of the business" suggests that…
options: the numbers matter more than the reasons behind them
the ledger should be archived and rarely opened
neglecting it means losing the ability to explain the past
only senior staff may read it
items.why: Inferência: se é a memória, negligenciá-la faz o negócio esquecer o porquê — daí a semana de "detective work".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily durante a varredura semanal das contas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, this is my weekly sweep of the suspense and inter-company accounts, and I am not thrilled with what I am seeing. Three entries have been sitting here, unexplained, for over a month. That is exactly what should never happen.

The first one is a cash difference that someone parked in suspense back in June. I understand the instinct — you cannot make it balance, so you push it somewhere safe. But suspense is not a safe place. It is a waiting room, and the rule is simple: whatever lands there clears the same day.

The second and third are inter-company. Our books say we are owed the money; the other side has never confirmed it. So right now I am reconciling both ledgers line by line, because a balance nobody can explain is a balance you cannot trust.

I am emailing the June poster this afternoon to ask what actually happened. If I let these age any longer, some auditor will ask the question first, and then it is a week of detective work instead of ten minutes today.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Emily doing at the start of the recording?
options: Her weekly sweep of the suspense and inter-company accounts
items.why: "this is my weekly sweep of the suspense and inter-company accounts".

items.q: How long have the three entries been sitting unexplained?
options: Since the start of the year
items.why: "unexplained, for over a month".

items.q: Why does Emily say the money in the inter-company accounts cannot be trusted yet?
options: The auditor has already rejected it
The amount is too small to matter
It was posted in the wrong currency
The other side has never confirmed it
items.why: "the other side has never confirmed it… a balance nobody can explain is a balance you cannot trust."

items.q: What does Emily mean by calling suspense "a waiting room"?
options: It is only used at year-end
It is where entries pause briefly and must not stay
It is the safest place to store differences
It is a room reserved for auditors
items.why: Inferência: sala de espera = passagem rápida; a regra é que tudo que cai ali sai no mesmo dia.

items.q: What is Emily's attitude toward acting now rather than later?
options: She is indifferent to when it gets resolved
She thinks it can safely wait for the audit
She prefers to escalate it to her manager
She would rather spend ten minutes today than a week later
items.why: Inferência: "a week of detective work instead of ten minutes today" — ela quer resolver já para evitar o custo maior.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Every invoice must be posted to the correct account." To post here means to…
options: record an entry in the ledger
items.why: To post = lançar, registrar a entrada no livro razão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At month-end we ___ the bank statement against the cash account to catch any difference."
items.why: To reconcile = conciliar: comparar dois registros para achar diferenças.

items.q: "A suspense account is where an entry sits until we know where it belongs." It is best described as…
items.why: Suspense account = conta transitória, onde o lançamento espera até ser corretamente classificado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The balance looked ___ , so she flagged it and asked the desk to explain the movement."
items.why: Odd = estranho; um saldo estranho merece uma pergunta imediata.

items.q: "If you neglect the ledger, small problems grow into big ones." To neglect means to…
options: fail to look after or maintain
items.why: To neglect = negligenciar, deixar sem o cuidado necessário.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem no dia a dia do razão. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The controller has to sign off on the month-end close before we publish." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Please clear the suspense entry today." To clear an entry means to…
options: resolve it and move it to its correct place
items.why: Clear = baixar/resolver: dar o destino correto ao lançamento.

items.q: "A strange balance cropped up in the cash account overnight." To crop up means to…
items.why: Crop up = surgir de repente, aparecer sem aviso.

items.q: "We need to follow up on the inter-company difference with the other office." To follow up on means to…
options: take further action to pursue it
items.why: Follow up on = dar sequência, cobrar/apurar depois de um primeiro contato.

items.q: "If we let these entries age, they will pile up and become impossible to explain." To pile up means to…
items.why: Pile up = acumular; os itens não resolvidos vão se empilhando.
